title: Story stamp
description: The shared story fields (decision 0058 rule 7), built once by src/storyStamp.js and carried by every view that names a story: index/active.json and all.json rows, the story view, index/web.json threads[id] (without iso3, which keeps its web meaning there) and index/analyses.json. The story view keeps its own `line` object {text, week, cites}, so it carries every field here except `line`. Each carrier references the single properties below ($ref) and lists them as required. `themeId` (step 4) is the id of the theme the story is in (index/themes.json), null when it is in none. A missing value is null and the field beside it says why (0037 section 6).

title.description: the story's one title: the headline of its newest non-article entry within the last 30 days (titleOf, 0037 amendment of 2026-11-04), else its newest entry overall; null for a story with no entries. analysis.threadTitle is the model's paraphrase, not this.

line.description: the weekly review's one-sentence reading, no fallback text (rule 5); null with lineReason when there is none

lineWeek.description: the ISO week of that reading

name.description: decision 0065: the story's name from the weekly review (reading subtype `name`, at most 8 words, cites the story, not a copy of a headline); the newest standing one, kept across weeks until the review gives another. null when the review has not named the story or every name was rejected; pages then show `title`. A merged-away story's alias row has null; the survivor keeps its own name.

iso3.description: valid country codes (iso3Names.json) plus EUU, sorted; WLD, LAT, UNK and anything else removed

regions.description: region names (rule 2) of every country, sorted; [] for no country

tier.description: tierFromScore(riskScore); null with tierReason when the story has no scored analysis

riskAt.description: the analysis generatedAt that the score and tier are as old as

lastEntryAt.description: the `at` of the story's newest news entry (an entry fact, merged stories' entries included; forecasts, verdicts, story-born, merges and placed articles do not count); null when the story has no news entry. Themes count new facts from this, not from lastFactAt.

category.description: the raw `category` of the newest news entry that has a non-empty one; null when none. Not a crisis type: the frontend (crisisHue.js) owns the category -> crisis type map.

themeId.description: theme-<threadId of the theme anchor> (rule 4); null when the story is in no theme (themes hold 3 stories or more)
